ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have not completed FIN 300 will be removed from FIN 321. To pass Finance 321 you must pass the assessment of pre-requisite knowledge and skills exam given in the first two weeks of the semester. Registration restricted to Finance and Actuarial Science majors. Additional Gies College of Business Majors will be added three weeks after priority registration. FOR STUDENTS RECEIVING A RESERVED CLOSED ERROR: There are currently reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions at the end of the first week of class on Friday by 10am.
